words.definition: located, happening, or used outside a building
words.example: The company picnic will be held at an outdoor venue this year.
words.exampleTranslation: 今年的公司野餐會在戶外場地舉行。

words.definition: a rectangular case used for carrying clothes and belongings while traveling
words.example: He packed his suitcase the night before his business trip.
words.exampleTranslation: 他在出差前一晚就打包好了行李箱。

words.definition: the place to which someone or something is traveling
words.example: Please confirm your final destination when booking the flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 訂機票時請確認你的最終目的地。

words.definition: a person's job or profession
words.example: Please state your occupation on the visa application form.
words.exampleTranslation: 請在簽證申請表上填寫你的職業。

words.definition: to delay an event to a later time
words.example: The board meeting was postponed due to a scheduling conflict.
words.exampleTranslation: 董事會議因為行程衝突而延後了。

words.definition: to say the opposite of, or be inconsistent with, a previous statement
words.example: The new sales figures contradict what was reported last quarter.
words.exampleTranslation: 新的銷售數字跟上一季的報告相互矛盾。

words.definition: a device with a folding frame and fabric, used for protection from rain
words.example: Bring an umbrella; the forecast calls for rain during the conference.
words.exampleTranslation: 帶把雨傘吧，預報說研討會期間會下雨。

words.definition: a conclusion reached based on evidence and reasoning
words.example: Based on the survey, a reasonable inference is that customers want faster delivery.
words.exampleTranslation: 根據這份調查，一個合理的推論是顧客希望更快的到貨速度。

words.definition: a portable telephone that operates over a wireless network
words.example: Please switch your cellphone to silent mode during the presentation.
words.exampleTranslation: 簡報期間請將手機切換為靜音模式。

words.definition: taking up little space; small and efficiently arranged
words.example: The compact printer fits easily on a small office desk.
words.exampleTranslation: 這台小巧的印表機很容易就能放在小型辦公桌上。

words.definition: goods that are bought and sold
words.example: All summer merchandise is now thirty percent off.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有夏季商品現在都打七折。

words.definition: a person employed to greet visitors and answer calls at an office or hotel
words.example: Ask the receptionist for a visitor badge when you arrive.
words.exampleTranslation: 抵達時請向接待員索取訪客識別證。

words.definition: a person qualified to treat diseases and conditions of the teeth
words.example: She left work early for a dentist appointment.
words.exampleTranslation: 她提早下班去看牙醫。

words.definition: an official document or card proving who someone is
words.example: Visitors must show identification before entering the building.
words.exampleTranslation: 訪客進入大樓前必須出示身分證明。

words.definition: a printed or digital ticket that can be exchanged for a discount
words.example: You can use this coupon for ten percent off your next purchase.
words.exampleTranslation: 你可以用這張折價券在下次購物享有九折優惠。

words.definition: to leave, especially to start a journey
words.example: The train will depart from platform three at noon.
words.exampleTranslation: 這班火車將於中午從第三月台出發。

words.definition: to change a planned time for an event to a different time
words.example: We had to reschedule the interview because of the storm.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們因為暴風雨必須重新安排面試時間。

words.definition: a specific action or method used to achieve a particular goal
words.example: Offering free shipping is a common tactic to boost online sales.
words.exampleTranslation: 提供免運費是提升網路銷售常見的策略。

words.definition: the process of repairing and improving a building
words.example: The lobby will be closed during the renovation next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 大廳在下個月整修期間將會關閉。

words.definition: an improvement made to a product or service, often to a better version
words.example: Frequent customers are eligible for a free room upgrade.
words.exampleTranslation: 常客有資格獲得免費房型升級。
